question: Which firm / tradable universe / book / risk scale survives prop-firm rules with high probability and stays profitable over 3 and 12 months, rather than maximizing return?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-03 before any v2 simulation. Same rule snapshot and simulator as prop-firm-v1 (config/prop_firm_v1.json, src/orderflow_edge_lab/prop_sim.py). Tradable lists are not published in verifiable form, so universes are liquidity proxies chosen without any return information. All return series are historical (seen), so results are descriptive; development (70 coins) and confirmation (60 untouched coins) are evaluated separately.

universes.HyroTrader: all coins of the sample (Bybit lists 700+ perps)
universes.Breakout: the 30 coins of the sample with the highest median daily dollar volume (Breakout lists about 62 Kraken pairs)
universes.FTMO: the 10 coins of the sample with the highest median daily dollar volume (FTMO's crypto CFD list is small)
universes.liquidity_measure: median over the whole sample of daily sum(volume x close) from the 8h bars; no return information

books.S4_blend: multi-premia blend rebuilt on the firm's universe
books.H10_human: the blend held as its 10 largest positions, daily 08:00 UTC check-in
books.H5_human: the blend held as its 5 largest positions, daily 08:00 UTC check-in

simulation.challenge: same as v1 but each phase may run up to 365 days (firms here have no time limit); outcomes: pass, breach (a loss limit hit), stuck (target not reached in 365 days)
simulation.funded: after a pass, 365 funded days, profits withdrawn every 30 days; the account ends at the first breach
simulation.buffer: 0.8 on every loss limit, as in v1

metrics: ev_per_fee = (P(pass) x mean payout - fee) / fee
works_rule: a configuration WORKS if, on BOTH samples: breach_rate <= 0.25, funded_survival_12m >= 0.70, p_paid_by_3m >= 0.50 and ev_per_fee > 0. Among those that work, the one with the highest minimum (over samples) funded_survival_12m is reported first.
